name: s4-refund-repeat
description: The 'same shape' ticket days later — the ablation pair. Run twice by the runner: control (retrieval off) then treatment (retrieval on). Watch the trace panel compare.

messages: Hi — Dana Whitfield at Contoso (dana.w@contoso.example), Enterprise plan. We were double-billed $129 for Acme Cloud Storage last month. Can you process the refund?

One more thing: our ops lead also wants a $400 refund for unused spot capacity on his Pro account. What's the process for that — can you just issue it, or is there an approval path? Walk me through exactly what happens.
